When should we expect the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, and when will Apple officially announce the date? Apple has yet to send out invitations, but its past announcement record gives us a fairly consistent time frame.

Apple iPhone launch event announcement dates: 2020–2025

Apple has announced its annual iPhone launch event exactly two weeks beforehand for four consecutive years. Below are the announcement dates for Apple's past six iPhone launch events, and what they suggest for September 2026.

Model Event announcement Event date Delta iPhone 17 Tuesday, August 26, 2025 Tuesday, September 9, 2025 14 days iPhone 16 Monday, August 26, 2024 Monday, September 9, 2024 14 days iPhone 15 Tuesday, August 29, 2023 Tuesday, September 12, 2023 14 days iPhone 14 Wednesday, August 24, 2022 Wednesday, September 7, 2022 14 days iPhone 13 Tuesday, September 7, 2021 Tuesday, September 14, 2021 7 days iPhone 12 Tuesday, October 6, 2020 Tuesday, October 13, 2020 7 days

The pandemic disrupted Apple's regular iPhone launch event schedule in 2020 and 2021. The iPhone 12 launch event was postponed to October, and both the iPhone 12 and iPhone 13 launch events were announced with only 7 days' notice.

However, since 2022, Apple's scheduling has been highly consistent. Each iPhone launch event has been announced exactly 14 days beforehand.

When will the iPhone 18 Pro / iPhone Ultra launch event take place?

Apple has not yet officially announced the date of its next iPhone launch event, but the strongest candidate date at present is September 9 (Wednesday).

Apple provided its first official clue this week, opening up applications for US retail employees to participate in its "Event Support Experience Program" held in California. Apple told employees that the event would take place in the first half of September.

Bloomberg notes that a Wednesday is slightly more likely because September 7 (Monday) is Labor Day. Choosing a Wednesday allows Apple to preserve the weekday business travel window it has historically offered to attendees.

When will Apple announce the date of its new iPhone launch event?

If Apple holds the launch event on September 9 and continues its pattern from the past four years, it will announce the date exactly two weeks earlier, on August 26 (Wednesday).

This makes August 26 the most likely predicted date for the iPhone 18 launch event invitation. August 25 (Tuesday) remains another possibility, but this would create a 15-day gap, failing to continue Apple's recent 14-day pattern.

Expected content of Apple's September 2026 launch event

This year's product lineup will make the event particularly noteworthy. Apple is expected to unveil three new flagship iPhones: the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max, and its first foldable iPhone (possibly named the iPhone Ultra).

Notably, the standard iPhone 18 will not make an appearance. Apple is expected to begin splitting its release schedule from this cycle, holding back the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 until spring 2027.

September is also traditionally when Apple launches new Apple Watch hardware. AirPods sometimes make an appearance at the event, although they don't receive updates every year.

This event will mark another "first" for Apple. John Ternus will take over as CEO on September 1, with Tim Cook moving to the role of Executive Chairman of the Board. This will be the first iPhone launch event of the Ternus era.
